name: Visor Finance
rootCause: The malicious contract attacked Visor's OHM-ETH 1% LP management contract. Funds in the targeted pool were recovered by Visor just hours after the attack. The funds deposited by users into Visor are not at risk.

descriptions.text: The malicious contract attacked Visor's OHM-ETH 1% LP management contract. Funds in the targeted pool were recovered by Visor just hours after the attack. The funds deposited by users into Visor are not at risk.

Visor Finance's OHM-ETH Uniswap V3 Hypervisor was exploited on Ethereum Mainnet on 25 November 2021, resulting in losses of about $976,000. The attacker used flash-loaned WETH to manipulate the pool spot price and mint inflated share receipts, then redeemed those shares for an outsized amount of assets. The deposit-share calculation in Visor Finance's Uniswap V3 Hypervisor contract used the current, manipulable AMM spot price and tick during deposits. A flash-loan-funded price manipulation allowed a minimal OHM deposit to mint shares at an artificially high rate, breaking trust in the spot price for share accounting.
